marina.title: Marina Penthouse Renovation
marina.description: A full penthouse renovation on Dubai Marina, pairing custom joinery with a terrace fit-out designed for entertaining, coordinated from technical drawings through to final handover.
marina.brief: The client, a longtime Dubai Marina resident upgrading to a marina-view penthouse, wanted the raw shell turned into a home built for both daily living and hosting, without waiting through a slow, multi-contractor process.
marina.approach: We began with a full technical survey and a joinery-led design language that carried through every room, from the entry console to the primary suite's wardrobe wall. Custom furniture and cabinetry were manufactured in our own workshop while the site team executed civil, MEP and finishing works in parallel, keeping the ten-week timeline intact. The terrace was treated as a fully specified room in its own right: weatherproof joinery, outdoor lighting and a built-in servery designed around how the client entertains.

highlights.title: Custom joinery throughout
highlights.body: Every cabinet, console and wardrobe wall built in-house and fitted to the millimetre.

highlights.title: Terrace built for entertaining
highlights.body: Weatherproof joinery, lighting and a servery designed around how the client hosts.

highlights.title: One team, one schedule
highlights.body: Design, approvals and site execution run by the same accountable team throughout.

highlights.title: Handover in 10 weeks
highlights.body: From technical drawings to final snagging, on the timeline agreed at kickoff.

downtown.title: Downtown Villa Fit-Out
downtown.description: A complete villa fit-out in Downtown Dubai, civil, MEP, finishes and joinery coordinated under one team, from site mobilisation to snagging and handover.
downtown.brief: A family relocating to Downtown Dubai needed a full villa fit-out completed before the lease on their temporary residence expired, leaving no room for delays between design, approvals and execution.
downtown.approach: Civil, MEP and finishing works were sequenced against building management's approval timeline from day one, so the schedule never stalled waiting on paperwork. Our own site team ran the project from demolition through to snagging, with weekly progress walkthroughs and quality checks logged against the approved drawings, so nothing was left to interpretation between design and delivery.

highlights.title: Approvals ran in parallel
highlights.body: NOC and permit submissions sequenced alongside design so site works started on schedule.

highlights.title: Full civil & MEP scope
highlights.body: Structural, plumbing, electrical and HVAC works executed to the approved drawings.

highlights.title: Weekly quality walkthroughs
highlights.body: Site inspections logged against the drawings at every stage, not just at handover.

highlights.title: Clean handover in 12 weeks
highlights.body: Snagging closed out before keys were handed back to the family.

albarari.title: Al Barari Kitchen & Joinery
albarari.description: A bespoke kitchen concept for an Al Barari villa, designed around the client's cooking and entertaining habits and manufactured in-house to millimetre-accurate tolerances.
albarari.brief: For an Al Barari villa owner who cooks and entertains often, a showroom-template kitchen wasn't going to work. The brief called for a layout and storage plan built around how the household actually uses the space.
albarari.approach: We spent time understanding cooking habits, appliance preferences and entertaining patterns before a single cabinet was drawn. The resulting concept pairs an island built for prep and casual dining with a fully concealed scullery kitchen for the messier side of cooking, all manufactured in-house to millimetre-accurate tolerances so the fit against the villa's existing structure is exact.

highlights.title: Built around real habits
highlights.body: Layout shaped by how the client cooks and entertains, not a showroom template.

highlights.title: Concealed scullery kitchen
highlights.body: A second working kitchen keeps the show kitchen guest-ready at all times.

highlights.title: In-house manufacturing
highlights.body: Cabinetry built and finished under one roof for consistent quality.

highlights.title: Millimetre-accurate fit
highlights.body: Site-measured and fabricated to match the villa's existing structure exactly.

jbr.title: JBR Apartment Refresh
jbr.description: An apartment renovation in JBR combining bathroom and living space updates with custom joinery, fitted to match the building's approval requirements and the client's finish palette.
jbr.brief: An owner-occupied JBR apartment needed a bathroom and living space refresh that met the building's strict approval requirements, without the resident having to vacate for the full renovation period.
jbr.approach: We prepared and submitted the required building documentation before any site works began, then phased the renovation so key living areas stayed usable for as long as possible. Custom joinery was fabricated off-site and installed in short, scheduled windows to minimise disruption, with finishes matched to the client's palette across both the bathroom and living space.

highlights.title: Building approvals secured first
highlights.body: Documentation submitted and cleared before any site works began.

highlights.title: Phased around daily life
highlights.body: Renovation sequenced so the apartment stayed liveable for as long as possible.

highlights.body: Cabinetry built in our workshop, installed in short, scheduled site windows.

highlights.title: Matched finish palette

AboutStory.titlePlain1: Built to close the gap between
AboutStory.body1: Bellvero Group started from a frustration shared by homeowners across the UAE: design studios draw beautiful renders, contractors execute someone else's drawings, and nobody owns the outcome when things fall through the cracks.
AboutStory.body2: So we built one studio that carries a project from the first concept sketch, through authority approvals and on-site renovation, to custom joinery and final handover, with one team accountable at every single stage.
AboutStory.body3: Today that means over 150 homes and commercial spaces across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the Northern Emirates, each delivered through the same coordinated, no-surprises process.

AboutPage.title: A Family Business. A Shared Standard.
AboutPage.description: Bellvero Group brings design, engineering, project delivery and bespoke joinery together for homes and commercial spaces in Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

AboutFounders.heading: Two Founders, One Standard of Work
AboutFounders.body1: In 2021 two brothers started their own renovation and construction business. Today that work continues as Bellvero Group.
AboutFounders.body2: Each of them brought an established career into it. One had spent his working life as an engineer on large construction sites in the UAE, holding chief engineer positions with contracting companies. The other had managed construction projects in several countries. A third partner is responsible for client relations.
AboutFounders.body3: That background shapes how we work. An interior is a connected project: the design has to be technically buildable, the works have to follow an agreed scope, and the furniture has to fit the space it was made for. Keeping those decisions connected is the reason the family stays directly involved rather than delegating the project and stepping away.

chiefEngineer.bio: Leads the technical direction of Bellvero Group. Before the family business, held chief engineer positions with UAE contracting companies on large residential, commercial and public buildings in Dubai and Abu Dhabi. On a private project that experience is applied where mistakes are expensive to correct: checking that the design can actually be built in your property, coordinating mechanical, electrical and plumbing works with the interior, and reviewing the technical decisions before works proceed.

projectManagement.bio: Leads project management, with eighteen years of experience in construction, including work as a project manager on projects in several countries. At Bellvero Group leads the project managers: how the programme is planned, how site teams, production and suppliers are coordinated, and how issues raised on site are resolved and reported back to you.

clientRelations.bio: Represents the owners in client relations. Takes the first conversation, establishes your priorities and the likely scope of work, and hands the brief to the designers, engineers and project managers. The role is to keep the communication between you and the team consistent: that what was discussed at the start is what appears in the proposal, and that you always know who is responsible for the next step.

AboutExperience.heading: The Experience Behind Bellvero
AboutExperience.intro: The experience the founders bring to Bellvero. These projects were delivered by their previous employers.
AboutExperience.body: In practice this means the technical review of your design before works start, coordination between the interior and the engineering systems, and a defined set of stages that the founders check. Your day-to-day contact remains your project manager.

AboutProduction.heading: Made for the Project
AboutProduction.body: Our own production makes bespoke cabinetry, with glass and stone work also carried out by our team. Upholstered furniture and other selected products are sourced to suit the agreed design. Production visits can be arranged by appointment.
